# Phase Two — Exact Surfaces And Twenty Improvements

## Immediate source surfaces
- `scripts/awtsmoos/ui/productMemory*.js`
- `scripts/awtsmoos/ui/foundation.js`
- Apps catalog runtime/view modules under `apps/scripts/filter/` and `apps/scripts/catalog/`
- Games storefront projection/presentation modules under `games/scripts/storefront/`
- `shared/commerce/surface.js` and the existing commerce footer contract
- `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/server/staticServerLifecycle.js` plus DB/config initialization
- Wallet reservation/reconciliation modules/tests under `api/wallet/`
- Existing share/export/import/handoff modules discovered from actual code

## Twenty improvements over the unfinished retention wave
1. Test the route-memory core before any global import.
2. Reject any retention module over 119 lines by architectural split, never compression.
3. Keep storage route-only and non-JSON.
4. Make storage denial/failure completely non-fatal.
5. Record only canonical product routes, never hub routes.
6. Bound recents to a small deterministic list.
7. Preserve original catalog order for non-recent records.
8. Avoid nested buttons inside product anchors.
9. Put favorite interaction inside the existing universal commerce sheet.
10. Use `aria-pressed` and native buttons for favorite state.
11. Show catalog Recent/Favorite state as noninteractive badges.
12. Keep Apps search/filter semantics unchanged after recent-first projection.
13. Keep Games category/group semantics unchanged after recent-first projection.
14. Refresh catalog badges after favorite changes without page reload if existing event seams permit it.
15. Reuse one shared stylesheet with mobile, focus, high-contrast, and reduced-motion rules.
16. Runtime-prove at 390px and desktop widths.
17. Preserve the already-green 63-test release baseline.
18. Measure full-server startup only with an isolated temporary DB root.
19. Add reconciliation evidence before increasing paid-economic complexity.
20. Write exact continuation state for anything genuinely unfinished.
